title: High-Order Summation-By-Parts Schemes for First-Order Hyperbolic Systems in Curvilinear Coordinates with Singularities
summary: Formulating stable numerical methods for hyperbolic systems in curvilinear coordinate with singularities, e.g. spherical coordinates, is complicated by the presence of these singularities. We present a method for constructing high-order accurate, energy-stable finite difference operators satisfying the Summation-by-Parts (SBP) property on spherical domains, extending ideas presented by [C. Gundlach, J. M. Martín-García, and D. Garfinkle, CQG 30, 145003 (2013)].
